newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas plans South Texas NGL plant.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas plans South Texas NGL plant.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp said Wednesday its directors approved construction of a natural gas liquids plant in the Agua Dulce area of Nueces County, Texas.

The company said it is engaged in discussions with potential partners concerning participation in the $42 million project, for which Jefferies & Co Inc and Oppenheimer & Co Inc are acting as financial advisors.
The plant will have processing capacity of 750 million cubic feet of natural gas per day and will produce some 40,000 barrels per day of natural gas liquids, TransTexas said.

To be located in an area where 15 major interstate and intrastate natural gas pipelines converge with eight NGL pipelines, the processing plant is projected to generate up to $62 million in annual cashflow, the company said.

TransTexas said its demand for NGL processing capacity has risen beyond that available through the company's present processing arrangement. Construction of this new facility will increase company cashflow through incremental volumes of NGL's produced, improved efficiency and lowered processing expenses.
